comparator_statement.readable: For all r, s ∈ (1, ∞] (ℝ≥0∞) there is a *-isomorphism Φ : L(F_r) → L(F_s) that carries the trace of L(F_s) back to the trace of L(F_r) and is a homeomorphism for the σ-weak (ultraweak) topologies; i.e. a normal trace-preserving *-isomorphism. Here L(F_n) (n ∈ ℕ) and L(F_∞) are group von Neumann algebras (bicommutants of the left regular representation) and, for non-integer r, L(F_r) is DEFINED as the normalised corner p(L(F_2) ⊗̄ B(ℓ²))p with (τ⊗Tr)(p) = 1/√(r−1).

def cornerSubalgebra (p : A) (hp : IsStarProjection p) : NonUnitalStarSubalgebra ℂ A where
  carrier := {x | p*x=x ∧ x*p=x}
  zero_mem' := by simp
  add_mem' hx hy := by constructor <;> simp [mul_add,add_mul,hx.1,hx.2,hy.1,hy.2]
  mul_mem' hx hy := by
    constructor
    · rw [← mul_assoc,hx.1]
    · rw [mul_assoc,hy.2]
  smul_mem' c x hx := by
    constructor
    · rw [mul_smul_comm,hx.1]
    · rw [smul_mul_assoc,hx.2]
  star_mem' hx := by
    constructor
    · simpa only [star_mul,hp.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq] using congrArg star hx.2
    · simpa only [star_mul,hp.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq] using congrArg star hx.1
